verdict.rationale: Conductor has no documented CLI or headless mode. It does offer an API that can create cloud workspaces, send prompts to the coding agent, and read its replies. It also offers routines that run agents on a schedule or via GitHub Action, plus a hosted MCP server, so scripted automation is possible but limited to cloud workspaces. Missing for 10: a non-interactive CLI/headless invocation for local workspaces, a published API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), detailed scripting docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
